_comment: Spot-beam ID -> place. A BulletinBoard names its beam by number only,
so this table supplies the geography.
Each entry records where it came from in 'source', so an observed fact
reported  - told to the project by an operator of a receiver
broadcast - decoded from a SpotBeamMap AVP (TS 102 744-3-1 5.4.10)
The broadcast map has now been caught, on the 10 minute 1534.500 MHz
capture: seven beams, each twice with identical geometry, parsed by
bgan/beams.py:spot_beam_map. Those entries carry their polygon centre
and the places that fall inside by point-in-polygon, and they are
authoritative -- 134 was 'reported' as Brisbane and the broadcast
Only the serving beam and its six neighbours are broadcast, not the
whole map, so this file still needs 'reported' entries elsewhere.

104.name: Melbourne
104.note: reported as one of 118/104 covering Melbourne; not in the broadcast neighbourhood, so still unresolved. The lattice predicts 104 one column west of 118, centred near lon +140, which would put Melbourne close to their shared edge -- which would explain the ambiguity, but it is a prediction and not a measurement

118.name: Melbourne
118.note: reported as one of 118/104 covering Melbourne; not in the broadcast neighbourhood. The lattice predicts 118 one step south of 119, centred near (-38.6, +147), which would contain Melbourne -- prediction, not measurement

133.name: Sydney
133.note: centre (-35.0, +154.8); contains Sydney, Newcastle, Wollongong, Coffs Harbour

134.name: Brisbane
134.note: centre (-26.0, +153.5); contains Brisbane, Gold Coast, Toowoomba, Bundaberg, Rockhampton. Was reported independently before the map was decoded, and the broadcast agrees. Seen on the 1534.499 and 1534.500 MHz carriers, rnc 29 / bct 1 and 2

135.name: Coral Sea (north)
135.note: centre (-18.0, +152.8); almost entirely ocean, contains Willis Island

147.name: Tasman Sea / Lord Howe
147.note: centre (-30.3, +161.7); ocean, contains Lord Howe Island

148.name: Coral Sea (east)
148.note: centre (-22.0, +160.0); ocean, no populated place inside
